signals.title: Change-aware CI test selection
signals.problem: Selecting blocking test suites based on changed code, including test flakiness concerns.
limitations: One public comment does not establish prevalence or willingness to pay.
Need benchmark against existing selective-test solutions.
questions: How often do teams overspend time on unnecessary tests?
Which CI vendors already offer test-impact analysis?

signals.title: Local CI environment reproduction and debugging
signals.user_segment: Engineers maintaining CI and infrastructure scripts
signals.problem: Repeated pushes to test CI scripts when the CI environment is difficult to reproduce locally.
signals.source_locator: comment by wojciii and replies (thread lines 48–53)
limitations: A single claimed willingness to pay is not proven conversion.
Existing container-based CI tooling may already address parts of the problem.
Need independent user interviews or corroborating published observations before claiming general demand.
questions: How closely can local execution mirror hosted CI?
Which workflows cannot easily be reproduced?

signals.title: Tracking model and coding-agent changes
signals.user_segment: Developers using multiple AI models or coding agents
signals.problem: Model retirement, pricing, usage limits and version changes scattered across providers.
signals.source_locator: founder description on Product Hunt product page
limitations: Founder story is not independently verified user need.
The product existing does not prove adoption or retention.
May overlap with changelogs, release feeds and existing monitoring tools.
questions: Are provider feeds enough for developers?
Which changes trigger measurable workflow failures?

disclaimer: Public source leads. Not independently corroborated or validated customer demand.
